title: fat cat v2 - pink
description: a pink overlay to change the look of fat cat v2!
body:
![a cartoony logo that says "fat cat v2"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/970aede70662a4342d6a13ea8d682a369d12ef38.png)

### ever felt like your minecraft experience was missing cats?

introducing... fat cat v2 in pink! it's the same pack but now you get to see more things in pink. because everything is better in pink. armor? pink. diamonds? pink. hearts? pink.
___

### read me first!!

this is an **extension/overlay** and not a standalone pack!

please update to the latest pack release here: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fat-cat-v2/versions. this overlay will be updated if any affected textures are updated.
